name: Jansen Stead
summary: Jansen Stead is the northernmost farmstead in Westfall, situated just down the road from the bridge to Elwynn Forest. Like much of the surrounding breadbasket, the homestead has fallen out of peasant hands and is swarming with rogue mechanical Harvest Watchers and roving Defias bandits.

sections.title: A Fallen Homestead
sections.body: Positioned right past the Elwynn border, the Jansen Stead represents the harsh reality greeting anyone traveling westward into Westfall. Once a flourishing family farm feeding the kingdom, its rightful occupants have been driven away by the rising tide of unrest. In their place, hostile Harvest Watchers—mechanical constructs associated with the Defias Brotherhood—patrol the blighted fields alongside brigands. Its proximity to the main road makes it a prominent early hazard for couriers and travelers moving between Goldshire and Sentinel Hill.

faq.answer: It is the very first farmstead on the right-hand side of the road as you cross the river bridge from Elwynn Forest into northeastern Westfall.

faq.q: Who lives at Jansen Stead right now?
faq.answer: The farm's original residents have been displaced. Today, the overgrown fields and derelict farmhouse are occupied by hostile Harvest Watchers and footpads loyal to the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.q: Why are mechanical scarecrows attacking people here?
faq.answer: Harvest Watchers are mechanical constructs that attack the people of Westfall. They patrol the farm alongside Defias agents. Their exact origins remain uncertain.

faq.q: Who is nearby asking for help?
aliases: who gives quests near elwynn bridge
faq.answer: Just south of the bridge near the entrance to Jansen Stead, Farmer Furlbrow and his wife Verna have set up camp by their broken wagon, having been forced off their own pumpkin patch down the road.

angles.text: For humans crossing over from the relative peace of Northshire and Elwynn, the ruin of Jansen Stead offers a harsh awakening to the economic crisis and banditry paralyzing Stormwind's rural heartland.
The farmstead's fall underscores the failure of Stormwind's leadership to secure its own borders, leaving defenseless homesteaders at the mercy of outlaws within sight of Elwynn Forest.
